mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom_snapshot_detail (snapshot_id, parent_code, child_code, parent_qty, child_qty, bom_version, effective_date, organization_code, body_scope, path_metadata) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{parentCode}, #{childCode}, #{parentQty}, #{childQty}, #{bomVersion}, #{effectiveDate}, #{organizationCode}, #{bodyScope}, #{pathMetadata})

INSERT INTO bom_snapshot_detail (snapshot_id, parent_code, child_code, parent_qty, child_qty, bom_version, effective_date, organization_code, body_scope, path_metadata) VALUES
(#{item.snapshotId}, #{item.parentCode}, #{item.childCode}, #{item.parentQty}, #{item.childQty}, #{item.bomVersion}, #{item.effectiveDate}, #{item.organizationCode}, #{item.bodyScope}, #{item.pathMetadata})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bom_snapshot_detail WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY parent_code, child_code
SELECT * FROM bom_snapshot_detail WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND parent_code=#{parentCode} ORDER BY child_code
